readout_other: hippocampal LFP, phase-amplitude coupling of gamma
direction_notes: During FUS, gamma amplitude locked to delta, theta and alpha phases and phase-amplitude coupling were greater than in the pre-FUS control.

device.model: focused transducer driven by USB-UT350T transmitter card (US Ultratek)

timing.protocol_description: Pulses of four cycles at 500 Hz pulse repetition rate, each stimulus consisting of 80 ultrasound pulses; stimulation duration 160 ms and pulse duration 1.6 microseconds.

source_quotes.n_subjects: A total of five Sprague–Dawley rats (male, 3-month old)
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: which had a central frequency of 2.5 MHz, a bandwidth of 50%
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.isppa_w_: The spatial-peak pulseaverage intensity of the ultrasound, measured using an ultrasonic sound power measuring instrument (YP0511F; Hangzhou Success Ultrasonic Power Technology Co. Ltd, Hangzhou, China), was 9.8 W/cm<sup>2</sup>.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.ispta_w_: The corresponding spatial-peak temporal-average intensity was 7.84 mW/cm<sup>2</sup>.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: The duration of the ultrasound stimulation and the pulse duration were 160 ms and 1.6 μs, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: In the experiment, the pulse repetition rate of the ultrasound was 500 Hz.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The duration of the ultrasound stimulation and the pulse duration were 160 ms and 1.6 μs, respectively.

flags.reason: Intensity measured with an ultrasonic power measuring instrument; medium and whether skull in path not stated.
Paper gives 7.84 mW/cm2; converted to W/cm2 as 0.00784 (unit conversion only).
Paper states 1.6 microseconds; recorded as 0.0016 ms.
Authors compared LFP before and during ultrasound emission with the transducer moved relative to the brain, concluding transducer sound had no effect; treated as a control experiment.
Pre-FUS recording served as the control; no sham arm.
Outcome is changes in gamma coupling, not clearly excitatory or inhibitory.
